recommended_successor.goal: Remove trainable constrained-root likelihoods from the scientific comparison rather than trusting numerically unstable guided-decoding logprobs.
recommended_successor.preferred_design: Use the constrained root only as a fixed, sampled nuisance/context variable; mask root tokens from both arms and train only the target decision. Broadcast still assigns terminal reward to the target while ReDCO assigns target-node LOO credit, so nuisance-target drift remains directly testable.
